chunks: That this is indeed the word of the noble Messenger,

key_terms.رَسُولٍ: Messenger, specifically referring to the angel Jibril or Prophet Muhammad in this context

ai.seo_question: Who is the noble Messenger referred to in Surah Al-Haqqah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah al-Haqqah (69:40) is often cited to affirm the identity of the 'noble Messenger' as Jibril (Gabriel), distinguishing him from the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who is the recipient. It underscores the purity and high status of the angelic bearer, reinforcing the divine authenticity of the Quran against the claims of the disbelievers who attributed it to a poet or soothsayer. This attribution serves as a theological anchor for the concept of Wahy (revelation) as a direct transmission from the divine realm through a respected intermediary.
